classification_rule.constraint_ids: extract cNN tokens from case basename
classification_rule.adversarial: SWOS-generated mutations are separate records and never relabelled as unchanged W3C tests

license_policy.current_policy_summary: W3C provides two mutually exclusive test-suite use routes: the 3-clause BSD route permits alteration for development but modified tests cannot support W3C performance/conformance claims; the W3C Test Suite License permits performance claims only against unmodified tests.
license_policy.legacy_non_retroactivity: The W3C policy explicitly states that it does not affect pre-policy test suites until they are modified to include the new licence statement. Therefore the historical PROV testcases MUST NOT be assumed dual-licensed merely because the current W3C policy exists.
license_policy.admission_rule: For every imported historical PROV testcase or collection, bind an exact licence/notice that actually accompanies or governs that testcase/collection at the pinned source. If no applicable notice can be demonstrated, keep the testcase catalogued but licence_status=unverified and do not redistribute it as T093 release evidence.
license_policy.unchanged_tests: retain exact upstream bytes and applicable notices; only make W3C performance/conformance claims where the exact historical test or collection is demonstrably covered by the W3C Test Suite License route
license_policy.modified_tests: only modify an upstream testcase when that exact source is demonstrably covered by a modification-permitting licence such as the W3C 3-clause BSD route; retain notices and never call modified cases authoritative W3C conformance tests
license_policy.swos_original: mark independently generated hostile/resource fixtures as SWOS-original; do not imply W3C authorship or conformance authority

existing_manual_catalogue.role: superseded as the catalogue authority by this pinned full-catalogue record; retain as historical preparation evidence

next_machine_step: Run the harvester in a networked controlled environment, require exactly 280 case identities, compute SHA-256 for every acquired representation, verify the exact licence/notice attached to the pinned historical testcase/collection, mark ambiguous rights fail-closed, then import only permitted fixtures into the production T093 manifest.
